title: Quest for the Round Tuit
author: Claude
blurb: King Dillydally IX says he'll save the kingdom as soon as he gets a round tuit. Lord Deadline stole it. A full role-playing adventure across Procrastia: four towns, four dungeons, side quests, a horseless carriage and a jester with a rubber chicken.

box.tagline: Somebody has to get around to it.
